control.title: Merchant and partner onboarding due diligence
control.description: Verify merchants and partners before onboarding (KYC, background checks, security assessment of their integration), monitor their transactions against their business profile, and offboard those that breach requirements.

evidence_hint: Onboarding checklist, KYC and background check records, security assessment, monitoring alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding records show KYC, background checks and a security assessment
Transactions are monitored against the merchant or partner profile

criteria_coverage.criterion: Onboarding records show KYC, background checks and a security assessment
Transactions are monitored against the merchant or partner profile

requirements.title: Merchant due diligence and background checks
requirements.guidance: Customer due diligence on merchants under the KYC Master Direction (with CKYCR retrieval), simplified checks for small merchants, and background checks.

requirements.title: Monitor merchant transactions against their profile
requirements.guidance: Monitor merchant transactions for consistency with the merchant's business.

requirements.title: Security assessment of merchants at onboarding
